blocks.text: In order to provide the Zscaler Zero Trust Browser service, Zscaler has the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify, and display the information from logs as defined in this article.
For Zero Trust Browser, logs are defined as follows:

blocks.item: Agent Logs: Agent logs capture information related to the agent’s operational health and posture collection activities. The default logging level is set to Info.

Workspaces Logs: Logs the status, operation, and errors related to user workspace management. These logs include information about whether the extension was installed using admin privilege, or which browser profile was created as per the installation/setup actions or failure/success related to the email validation for use of the product. The default log level is set to Info. The log verbosity is configurable by the user.

Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs: These logs capture telemetry-related logs such as policy evaluation related to browsing activities, heartbeat, authentication, audit, and diagnostic logs. They also capture configuration change logs such as policy modifications and administrative audit logs.

blocks.text: For the Cloud Browser Isolation feature, logs may also capture passwords that are entered by the user for password-protected files. This is required to allow viewing the file from within the Zero Trust Browser.

To enhance support and improve system performance analysis, logs may also contain local performance and diagnostic metrics, including technical and operational metrics related to network calls or time taken to perform actions like posture collections.

The Agent Logs and Workspaces Logs are stored on your users’ local machines and are only accessible by your users and administrators. These logs are not stored in Zscaler clouds. In case of any specific failure that you want to report to Zscaler, Zscaler will process, store, and use these logs for debugging purposes.

Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs are retained by Zscaler for a rolling period of six months during the term of subscription. You can request a shorter retention period. When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to applicable retention cycles.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs stored in the United States, the European Union, Singapore, or India.
